Author: JustPixelll
Name: Should I?
Punchline: Know what to sell, what to buy, and where your gil goes.
Description: FFXIV economy intelligence suite: sell optimization, executable buy discovery, native verification, gil cashflow tracking, FIFO trading P&L, and personal Market Board analytics.
Changelog:
# Should I? v2.1.0

## Faster cashflow categorization
- Common cashflow categories now have one-click icon shortcuts, with the complete category list still available through `...`.
- Icons use Dalamud's dedicated icon font.

## Manual vendor acquisition tracking
- Manually record normal-gil vendor purchases in Tycoon → Purchases with item, quantity, unit cost and Trade/Personal intent.
- Vendor trade lots use the same FIFO cost-basis and realized-P&L engine as Market Board purchases.
- Exact recent wallet decreases can be reconciled as Vendor without fabricating transactions.
- Purchases retain source identity: Market Board or Vendor (manual).

## Separate Should I Buy? lanes
- Market Board buys and Vendor → Market opportunities now have independent scans and result caches.
- Vendor candidates no longer consume Market Board shortlist/deep-analysis capacity.
- Vendor → Market has its own results table; Market Board screener, Deep Scan and portfolio stay focused on Market Board acquisition routes.
